title: 2025 Pokémon | Prismatic Evolutions | Explorer's Guidance Pokeball 107/131
categoryName: Toys & Hobbies:Collectible Card Games:CCG Individual Cards
descriptionText: The 2025 Pokémon Prismatic Evolutions Explorer's Guidance Pokeball 107/131 is a highly collectible card from the Pokémon Trading Card Game. This card, part of the Evolutions set, features the unique Explorer's Guidance character and is numbered 107 out of 131. With a manufacturing year of 2025, this card is a prized addition to any Pokémon TCG collection.
